name: Nox Ground Unit
title: Nox Ground Unit
note: Box W frame (X across, Y along the axle toward the front, Z up; the swap arm hub at the origin, the drone seat at (0, 167.1, 220.3)). In: the landing funnel v5 (13 Nov: the frame in two halves on four cross arms under the rain lid, each end wall on two lead-screw gearmotors; the halves and the arm print as drawn PROTOTYPES, the setup's room filled solid less its cuts; their engine pieces wait at OPTIMISE), latch v7 for both packs at the seat, the Scout v4 and the Overseer seated as they stand today, the swap arm from systems/swap_arm.assembly.json, the stand v2 prototype (drawn: mast, two base halves, two front rails, four TPU feet), the v2 enclosure sheets to W Z 145 and the PSU as boxes, the Scout's rain dome and the rain lid. Out: the electronics. Compatibility between the streams: tools/box_check.py, its result under the viewer.
